2026-11-01.title: All Saints · Solemnity
readings: A great multitude that no one could count
Lord, this is the people that longs to see your face
We shall see him as he is
2026-11-01.verse: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.

2026-11-08.title: Thirty-second Sunday in Ordinary Time
readings: Wisdom is found by those who seek her
My soul is thirsting for you, O Lord my God
God will bring with him those who have died
2026-11-08.verse: Keep awake therefore, for you know neither the day nor the hour.

2026-11-15.title: Thirty-third Sunday in Ordinary Time · World Day of the Poor
readings: The capable wife opens her hand to the poor
Blessed are those who fear the Lord
The day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night
2026-11-15.verse: His master said to him, ‘Well done, good and trustworthy slave; you have been trustworthy in a few things, I will put you in charge of many things; enter into the joy of your master.’

2026-11-22.title: Our Lord Jesus Christ, King of the Universe · Solemnity
readings: I myself will be the shepherd of my sheep
The Lord is my shepherd; there is nothing I shall want
Christ will hand over the kingdom to the Father, so that God may be all in all
Just as you did it to one of the least of these, you did it to me
2026-11-22.verse: And the king will answer them, ‘Truly I tell you, just as you did it to one of the least of these who are members of my family, you did it to me.’

2026-11-29.title: First Sunday of Advent
readings: O that you would tear open the heavens and come down
Lord, make us turn to you; let us see your face and we shall be saved
Waiting for the revealing of our Lord Jesus Christ
Keep awake, for you do not know when the master of the house will come
2026-11-29.verse: And what I say to you I say to all: Keep awake.

2026-11-02.title: The Commemoration of All the Faithful Departed (All Souls)
readings: The souls of the righteous are in the hand of God
The Lord is my shepherd; there is nothing I shall want
I will raise them up on the last day
2026-11-02.verse: This is indeed the will of my Father, that all who see the Son and believe in him may have eternal life; and I will raise them up on the last day.

2026-11-03.title: Tuesday of the Thirty-first Week in Ordinary Time
readings: I will praise you, Lord, in the assembly of your people
Come, for everything is ready now
2026-11-03.verse: At the time for the dinner he sent his slave to say to those who had been invited, ‘Come; for everything is ready now.’

2026-11-04.title: Wednesday of the Thirty-first Week in Ordinary Time · St Charles Borromeo, Bishop
readings: Shine like stars in the world
The Lord is my light and my salvation
Whoever does not carry the cross cannot be my disciple
2026-11-04.verse: Whoever does not carry the cross and follow me cannot be my disciple.

2026-11-05.title: Thursday of the Thirty-first Week in Ordinary Time
readings: I regard everything as loss because of Christ
Let hearts rejoice who search for the Lord
The lost sheep and the lost coin
2026-11-05.verse: Just so, I tell you, there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine righteous persons who need no repentance.

2026-11-06.title: Friday of the Thirty-first Week in Ordinary Time
readings: I rejoiced when I heard them say: let us go to the house of the Lord
2026-11-06.verse: And his master commended the dishonest manager because he had acted shrewdly; for the children of this age are more shrewd in dealing with their own generation than are the children of light.

2026-11-07.title: Saturday of the Thirty-first Week in Ordinary Time
readings: I can do all things through him who strengthens me
Blessed the man who fears the Lord
You cannot serve God and wealth
2026-11-07.verse: No slave can serve two masters; for a slave will either hate the one and love the other, or be devoted to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve God and wealth.

2026-11-09.title: The Dedication of the Lateran Basilica · Feast
readings: Water flowing from the Temple brings life
The waters of the river gladden the city of God
He was speaking of the temple of his body
2026-11-09.verse: Jesus answered them, “Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.”… But he was speaking of the temple of his body.

2026-11-10.title: Tuesday of the Thirty-second Week in Ordinary Time · St Leo the Great, Pope and Doctor
readings: The grace of God has appeared
The salvation of the just comes from the Lord
We are worthless slaves; we have done only our duty
2026-11-10.verse: So you also, when you have done all that you were ordered to do, say, ‘We are worthless slaves; we have done only what we ought to have done!’

2026-11-11.title: Wednesday of the Thirty-second Week in Ordinary Time · St Martin of Tours, Bishop
readings: He saved us by the water of rebirth
The Lord is my shepherd; there is nothing I shall want
Only one returned to give thanks
2026-11-11.verse: Then one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, praising God with a loud voice. He prostrated himself at Jesus' feet and thanked him. And he was a Samaritan.

2026-11-12.title: Thursday of the Thirty-second Week in Ordinary Time · St Josaphat, Bishop and Martyr
readings: No longer as a slave but as a beloved brother
Blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob
The kingdom of God is among you
2026-11-12.verse: For, in fact, the kingdom of God is among you.

2026-11-13.title: Friday of the Thirty-second Week in Ordinary Time
readings: Whoever abides in the teaching has both the Father and the Son
Blessed are they who follow the law of the Lord
2026-11-13.verse: Remember Lot's wife. Those who try to make their life secure will lose it, but those who lose their life will keep it.

2026-11-14.title: Saturday of the Thirty-second Week in Ordinary Time
readings: We ought to support such people, so that we may become co-workers with the truth
Blessed the man who fears the Lord
Pray always and do not lose heart
2026-11-14.verse: Then Jesus told them a parable about their need to pray always and not to lose heart.

2026-11-16.title: Monday of the Thirty-third Week in Ordinary Time
readings: You have abandoned the love you had at first
Those who are victorious I will feed from the tree of life
2026-11-16.verse: Jesus said to him, “Receive your sight; your faith has saved you.”

2026-11-17.title: Tuesday of the Thirty-third Week in Ordinary Time · St Elizabeth of Hungary, Religious
readings: I stand at the door and knock
I will seat the victor beside me on my throne
Today salvation has come to this house
2026-11-17.verse: For the Son of Man came to seek out and to save the lost.

2026-11-18.title: Wednesday of the Thirty-third Week in Ordinary Time
readings: Holy, holy, holy, the Lord God the Almighty
Holy, holy, holy Lord, mighty God!
2026-11-18.verse: He said to him, ‘Well done, good slave! Because you have been trustworthy in a very small thing, take charge of ten cities.’

2026-11-19.title: Thursday of the Thirty-third Week in Ordinary Time
readings: The Lamb who was slaughtered ransomed us for God
The Lamb has made us a kingdom of priests to serve our God
If you had only recognised the things that make for peace
2026-11-19.verse: As he came near and saw the city, he wept over it, saying, “If you, even you, had only recognized on this day the things that make for peace! But now they are hidden from your eyes.”

2026-11-20.title: Friday of the Thirty-third Week in Ordinary Time
readings: I took the little scroll and ate it
How sweet to my taste is your promise!
My house shall be a house of prayer
2026-11-20.verse: It is written, ‘My house shall be a house of prayer’; but you have made it a den of robbers.

2026-11-21.title: Saturday of the Thirty-third Week in Ordinary Time · The Presentation of the Blessed Virgin Mary
readings: The breath of life from God entered them
Blessed be the Lord, my Rock!
He is God not of the dead, but of the living
2026-11-21.verse: Now he is God not of the dead, but of the living; for to him all of them are alive.

2026-11-23.title: Monday of the Thirty-fourth Week in Ordinary Time
readings: They follow the Lamb wherever he goes
Lord, this is the people that longs to see your face
The poor widow put in more than all of them
2026-11-23.verse: He said, “Truly I tell you, this poor widow has put in more than all of them; for all of them have contributed out of their abundance, but she out of her poverty has put in all she had to live on.”

2026-11-24.title: Tuesday of the Thirty-fourth Week in Ordinary Time · Sts Andrew Dung-Lac and Companions, Martyrs
readings: The harvest of the earth is fully ripe
The Lord comes to judge the earth
Not one stone will be left upon another
2026-11-24.verse: Beware that you are not led astray; for many will come in my name and say, ‘I am he!’ and, ‘The time is near!’ Do not go after them.

2026-11-25.title: Wednesday of the Thirty-fourth Week in Ordinary Time
readings: They sing the song of Moses and the song of the Lamb
Great and wonderful are all your works, Lord, mighty God!
By your endurance you will gain your souls
2026-11-25.verse: But not a hair of your head will perish. By your endurance you will gain your souls.

2026-11-26.title: Thursday of the Thirty-fourth Week in Ordinary Time
readings: Fallen is Babylon the great; blessed are those invited to the marriage supper of the Lamb
Blessed are they who are called to the wedding feast of the Lamb
Stand up and raise your heads, because your redemption is drawing near
2026-11-26.verse: Now when these things begin to take place, stand up and raise your heads, because your redemption is drawing near.

2026-11-27.title: Friday of the Thirty-fourth Week in Ordinary Time
readings: I saw a new heaven and a new earth
Here God lives among his people
Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away
2026-11-27.verse: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.

2026-11-28.title: Saturday of the Thirty-fourth Week in Ordinary Time
readings: There will be no more night; the Lord God will be their light
Be alert at all times, praying
2026-11-28.verse: Be alert at all times, praying that you may have the strength to escape all these things that will take place, and to stand before the Son of Man.

2026-11-30.title: Saint Andrew, Apostle · Feast
readings: Faith comes from what is heard
Their voice has gone out through all the earth
Immediately they left their nets and followed him
2026-11-30.verse: And he said to them, “Follow me, and I will make you fish for people.” Immediately they left their nets and followed him.
